In the NDE chart of accounts, Other Purchased Services covers transportation, insurance, communication, printing, tuition and travel, not mainly professional services. This is a judgment call; it applies to all Exhibit N 'Other Purchased Services' lines (largest: SPED 59,898.37, Psych SPED 73,852.57).
'Other Expenses' has no breakdown, so mapping it to dues, training and travel is an assumption (dues and fees are typical, but it is not stated). It applies to every Exhibit N 'Other Expenses' line.
This is a county distribution of fines and license money, so intergovernmental can be defended and matches the statement's 'County receipts'. The label suggests fines and forfeitures instead.
